claim: V1 first run calls the deterministic executor once and records; unchanged V1 second run self-finalizes from replay with no new executor call; V2 changed button name forces a handoff and a second executor call, then passes.

target.name: tester-army/e2e replay cache with local web fixture

task.path_reachability: The test clicks Upgrade Plan then asserts role=status contains Pro, which is required for a passing act to be recorded. V2 changes only the button name to force replay divergence.

arms.fault: button name changed from Upgrade Plan to Upgrade Plan v2

witness.delivery: The app serves page.html with cache-control:no-store. Before each run the active variant hash is recorded. An independent executor-calls.jsonl is appended only when runStep is invoked; report.json supplies ActResult.modelCalls and cache mode/reason.
witness.checker: Executor invocation counter plus e2e report.json plus pre-run variant hashes and the pinned package versions.
blind_spots: The custom executor is deterministic code, not an LLM; this pilot tests the replay/cache harness, not model intelligence.
One changed button name covers one divergence class, not all stale-cache forms.
The pilot uses npm releases, not the previously inspected main branch.
A local Chrome/CDP session and local static server are environmental dependencies, not product behavior.

grading.rubric: Executor-call count and cache.mode/reason must agree with the preregistered claim; environment failures are INVALID.

invalid_rules: Browser, CDP endpoint, local app or required dependency unavailable before a product verdict can be reached.
Config or executor setup failure before the first action.
Active variant hash differs from the preregistered variant for that run.
Missing or unreadable report.json or executor-calls.jsonl after a completed run.

isolation.mode: Local static app, temporary CDP Chrome profile, one browser and one worker; telemetry disabled; no production, mobile, cloud browser, GitHub reporter or real model.
isolation.contamination: Original fixture files remain on disk, but the executor is deterministic code that only observes the browser and never reads them. Only the operator changes the active variant between runs.

ethics.blast_radius: Three local browser runs and temporary files under runs/e2e-replay-2026-10-24; no external model calls or third-party writes.
